description: Stack registry — the single source of truth mapping each surface to the stacks it supports, and each stack to its pack manifest. Agents, portable roles, the dev-workflow orchestrator, and init-workspace resolve a surface's stack from here instead of hardcoding .NET / React / Expo. To add a stack: add an entry under the surface's `stacks`, add a `packs` pointer, and author packs/<key>/pack.json + skills/<conventions-skill>. See packs/README.md.
